Canaux classés par nombre de sessions dé: Channels are ranked by number of sessions, highest first; the Sessions column gives the volume (all devices) and its change vs the previous period. Total = all devices combined (sessions and conversions added up, rate recalculated). Rate = sessions that triggered the valuation request ÷ sessions of the channel and device. The denominator is therefore sessions: this measure differs from the journey conversion rate (valuations ÷ home page visitors) and is used to compare channels with each other.
